Description

The core of RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling from the membrane to ERK, assembled from four smaller maps, each shown on its own page with its references: the RAS cycle, RAF activation, RAF activates MEK, and ERK activation by MEK. The maps meet on the species one makes and the next one uses: GTP-loaded RAS, the active RAF dimer, and MEK1/2 phosphorylated on its two activation-loop serines. None of the four was changed to join them. The references of every step are those of its own map.
